title: Order of Pronouns
theory:
Part-A
            When different Pronouns are used in a normal/positive sentence, follow the given
               order:
                                 2        +      3      +       1

                                     Second Person + Third Person + First Person
          Part-B
            When a mistake, fault, guilt, crime, or blame is expressed, follow the given order:
                                   1          +      2       +      3

                                     First Person + Second Person + Third Person
          Part-C
            When all Pronouns are used together in a plural or collective sense, follow the given
               order:
                                  1        +       2       +       3

                                     First Person + Second Person + Third Person
           Note
                1st Person                       I, We
                2 Person

                                                 You
                3 Person

                                                 He, She, It, They, Nouns
